method: The rows are in original catalog source order (7 basic source sets, then 6 original Read sets), NOT claimed to be the actual guided curriculum sequence. firstObservedWrittenForms are case-sensitive-to-inflection orthographic word forms normalized to Polish lowercase, not lexical lemmas, inflectional analysis, or learner-known vocabulary. rows.english: I am looking for a shirt
May I have the menu, please?

rows.polish: Czy mają Państwo coś bez mięsa?
rows.english: Do you have anything without meat?

rows.polish: Czy ma pan/pani menu po angielsku?
rows.english: Do you have a menu in English?
I’ll have the soup of the day
Which way to the city center?
Is this the train to Warsaw?
How do I get to the airport?

rows.polish: Czy mogę kupić bilet u kierowcy?
rows.english: Can I buy a ticket from the driver?
Where can I buy a ticket?
How long does the bus take?

rows.polish: Czy ten tramwaj jedzie do centrum?
rows.english: Does this tram go to the center?
You are going the right way
Excuse me, how do I get to …?

rows.polish: Czy to jest w tę stronę?

rows.english: Where is the nearest police station?
Can I make a phone call?

rows.polish: Proszę i dziękuję są bardzo ważne.
rows.english: Please and thank you are very important.
Good morning, I’d like a kilo of apples, please.

rows.polish: Jakie jabłka pan lubi? Czerwone czy zielone?
rows.english: Which apples do you like? Red or green?
Here you go, I’ll pay by card.

rows.polish: Przepraszam, czy może mi pani pomóc?
rows.english: Excuse me, can you help me?
I am looking for a white T-shirt.

rows.polish: Przepraszam, czy mogę przymierzyć tę koszulkę?
rows.english: Excuse me, can I try on this T-shirt?

rows.polish: Przymierzalnie są tam, po lewej stronie.
rows.english: The fitting rooms are there, on the left.
The T-shirt is good. I’ll take it.
Where is the cash desk, please?

rows.polish: Przepraszam, czy to miejsce jest wolne?
rows.english: Excuse me, is this seat free?

rows.polish: Czy ten tramwaj jedzie do centrum?
rows.english: Does this tram go to the city centre?
Yes, it goes to the centre.
At which stop do I need to get off?

rows.polish: Musi pan wysiąść na trzecim przystanku.
rows.english: You need to get off at the third stop.
Thank you very much for the information.
Excuse me, may I ask a question?

rows.polish: Przepraszam, czy tym tramwajem dojadę do centrum?
rows.english: Excuse me, does this tram go to the city centre?

rows.polish: Tak, ten tramwaj jedzie do centrum.
rows.english: Yes, this tram goes to the centre.
At which stop should I get off?
Please get off at the ‘Centrum’ stop.

rows.polish: Czy mogę kupić bilet w tramwaju?
rows.english: Can I buy a ticket on the tram?

rows.polish: Tak, może pan kupić bilet w automacie.
rows.english: Yes, you can buy a ticket in the machine.

rows.polish: Dzień dobry, poproszę dwa bilety do muzeum.
rows.english: Good morning, two tickets to the museum, please.

rows.polish: Do której godziny muzeum jest otwarte?
rows.english: Until what time is the museum open?
Today we are open until six p.m.

rows.polish: Szatnia jest na prawo, za schodami.
rows.english: The cloakroom is on the right, past the stairs.

rows.polish: Pierwsza wystawa jest na pierwszym piętrze.
rows.english: The first exhibition is on the first floor.
